exposure: Second stage of labor before surgery
outcome: Incidence of surgical site infection following cesarean delivery
Risk factors for surgical site infection
cohort: Women who gave birth by cesarean delivery in Nova Scotia, Canada, between January 1, 1997 and December 31, 2012
finding: The study found a decreasing incidence of surgical site infection following cesarean delivery over time, with several identifiable risk factors, some of which are potentially modifiable.
